posts.title: Agentic Video Understanding with Gemini & Spring Boot!
posts.description: I built Fhemni, a Spring Boot app that uses Gemini's agentic video understanding to turn long YouTube interviews into structured briefings with fact-checked claims — in Arabic, Darija, French, or English.

posts.title: A2UI & MCP: agents that send UIs, not just text!
posts.description: Exploring A2UI, Google's declarative protocol for agent-driven UIs, by building a Spring Boot MCP server. Includes a comparison with MCP Apps and the Generative UI landscape.

posts.title: Java 27 features: Compact Object Headers by default, JFR redaction & post-quantum TLS!
posts.description: A JEP-by-JEP tour of JDK 27, tested on the early-access build: compact object headers by default, G1 everywhere, JFR secret redaction and post-quantum TLS.
